select sl.class_path, sl.business_id, to_char(sl.create_time,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') as create_time, max(sl.create_user_name) as create_user_name, array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT sl.operation),'
') as operation, array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT sl.content),'
') as content from sys_log sl AND sl.class_path LIKE concat('%',#{params.classPath},'%') AND sl.business_id = #{params.businessId} AND sl.pid = #{params.pid} group by sl.class_path,sl.business_id,to_char(sl.create_time,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') order by to_char(sl.create_time,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') desc
